ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system $xOy$, the graph of the linear function $y = -2x$ intersects with the graph of the inverse proportion function $y = \frac{k}{x}$ at a point $A(-1, n)$. What is the equation of the inverse proportion function $y = \frac{k}{x}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point A $(-1, 2)$ lies on the graph of the linear function $y=-2x$,\\
$\therefore n=-2\times(-1)=2$\\
$\therefore$ The coordinates of point A are $(-1, 2)$\\
Since point A lies on the graph of the inverse proportion function,\\
$\therefore k=-2$\\
$\therefore$ The equation of the inverse proportion function is $\boxed{y=-\frac{2}{x}}$.
